people.gloss: Fishing alone in the snow on the cold river (Liễu Tông Nguyên: độc điếu hàn giang tuyết)
people.role: A founder (1140) and head of Lãnh Giang Phái; the man who pieced Hàn Giang's ice-hole sitting back together
people.appearance: A thin, stooped man with frost in his beard in every season, who speaks as if each word cost him a fish.
people.backstory: Lư Độc Điếu was a Liên Giang ice-fisher's son who, at twenty-five, sat down beside the last old men still cultivating on the river in Hàn Giang's way and asked them to teach him. Most were dying. The youngest of them, Bồ Tọa Tuyết (bo_toa_tuyet), lived. Over twenty years Lư wrote down every fragment they remembered, filled the gaps by sitting through the winters himself, and called the result the Lone Line Sitting Canon. In 1140 he and the fisher Đái Tuyết Lạp (dai_tuyet_lap) petitioned Băng Tâm, and the Pavilion granted the fishers of Liên Giang a licence to revive Hàn Giang's sitting (V088). The licence had a condition: Water only, because Ice belongs to the Pavilion. The school also escorts the ice-fish boats and pays the old tax in fish (A131). Đái went through the ice in 1168 at the seventh layer. Lư has sat at the eighth for forty years and cannot find the ninth.
people.wants: The true manual of Hàn Giang Môn, or the ninth layer by any road.
people.secret: He suspects the Liễu family of Liên Giang keep Hàn Giang's real method. He took Liễu Thoa Nhi into the school hoping she would show him, and is ashamed of it.

people.role: Grand elder: the last of the old ice-hole sitters of Liên Giang, who reached Kết Đan on the river alone
people.appearance: A tiny, ancient man in a frost-white straw cape who looks like a heap of snow until he speaks.
people.backstory: Bồ Tọa Tuyết was a fisher's boy on the Liên Giang ice in 880, sitting beside the old men who still kept Hàn Giang's way after four centuries. A boy of the next generation, Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang), cut ice holes beside them too before the Pavilion took him. The old men died one by one, and Bồ stayed. He never joined a sect and never wanted to, and he reached Kết Đan in 1010 on the river, alone, on fragments and patience. He taught what he remembered to Lư Độc Điếu (lu_doc_dieu) and joined the school as its grand elder in 1140 because the young man asked. In the winter of 1000 he found a cracked stone of Hàn Giang Môn under the ice of the ruin at place 216, and he has read it every winter since. It says the true sitting needs Ice in the root, and that a Water-only sitter stops at the eighth layer. The Pavilion's licence forbids Ice.
people.wants: To die sitting on the river, and before that to see one disciple reach the ninth layer.
people.secret: The stone under the ice: Lãnh Giang can never truly revive Hàn Giang under the Pavilion's licence. He has not told Lư, because it would break him.

people.role: Steward of the school's boats and the head's wife
people.appearance: A brisk marsh woman with reed-flower pins in her hair and an abacus at her belt.
people.backstory: From Lô Hoa Thôn, where reed flowers cover the marsh like snow in summer (A134). She married Lư Độc Điếu (lu_doc_dieu) in 1150 and has run everything in the school that does not involve sitting still: the boats, the ice-fish sales, the Pavilion's tax and its clerk Phạm Lãnh Vân (pham_lanh_van), who reads the books every spring. She thinks her husband's ninth layer is a fish that is not in the river.

people.role: Captain of the ice-fish boat escort
people.appearance: A loud, red-faced boatman who breaks the morning ice in the harbour of Tuyết Đăng Trấn with his elbow.
people.backstory: The one member of the school who cannot sit still, so Bồ Tọa Tuyết (bo_toa_tuyet) sent him to the boats. He leads the escort of the ice-fish fleet from Tuyết Đăng Trấn to Liên Giang alongside Trạc Anh's whalers, and he has fought off ice beasts and smugglers. He drinks with Ngạc Hải Tiêu (ngac_hai_tieu) and thinks the terrace should hunt its whale.

people.backstory: The talker of the two founders: he carried the petition to the Pavilion in 1140 and won the licence (V088) with Thẩm Hàn Giang's (tham_han_giang) word behind it. Impatient for the next layer, he sat the seventh on thin spring ice in 1168, and the river took him. Lư Độc Điếu (lu_doc_dieu) has never let a disciple sit on spring ice since.
